# Proud School & Academy (Proud Group of Institutions), Lahore

> Proud Group of Institutions runs two campuses on Raiwind Road, Lahore, Pakistan: Proud School, a primary and secondary school in Village Bhobtian, and Proud Academy, a Matric, FSc and subject coaching academy in Main Sher Shah, 100 Feet Road. Motto: "Be Proud of Nation". Admissions for 2026-2027 are open.

## Campuses
- Proud School: Village Bhobtian, Raiwind Road, Lahore. Phone/WhatsApp +92 304 7860046. Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
- Proud Academy: Main Sher Shah, 100 Feet Road, Raiwind Road, Lahore. Phone/WhatsApp +92 303 7860046. Monday to Saturday, 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM.
